title: Quantum Gaussian processes for prediction of channel observations
abstract: arXiv:2608.19306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a set of input states, we consider the task of predicting the expectation value of a Pauli observable at the output of an unknown quantum evolution, using only a limited number of measurements. Recently, quantum Gaussian process (QGP) regression was introduced for this task across various classes of unitary evolution. Here, we extend the QGP framework beyond unitary dynamics. In particular, we prove convergence of the channel's outputs to a QGP and derive the associated closed-form kernel under a uniform (Lebesgue measure) prior over quantum channels. The kernel's dimensional factor, however, dictates the required observation precision. While manageable when the channel and observable are restricted to small subsystems, exponential suppression precludes learning when the subsystem grows extensively with the system size. translated_title: 量子高斯过程用于信道观测预测
translated_abstract: 给定一组输入态，我们考虑在未知量子演化输出端预测泡利可观测量期望值的任务，仅使用有限数量的测量。最近，量子高斯过程（QGP）回归被引入用于各类酉演化下的此任务。在此，我们将QGP框架扩展到非酉动力学。特别地，我们证明了信道输出收敛到QGP，并在量子信道上的均匀（勒贝格测度）先验下推导了相关的闭式核。然而，核的维度因子决定了所需的观测精度。当信道和可观测量限制在小子系统时，这可以管理，但当子系统随系统规模广泛增长时，指数抑制阻碍了学习。由于勒贝格先验对许多应用过于宽泛，我们提出了一种经验贝叶斯启发式方法，用于重新调整先验以适应实际场景。
tldr: 本文扩展量子高斯过程回归到非酉量子信道，证明其收敛性并推导闭式核，同时提出经验贝叶斯方法应对高维系统中的指数抑制问题。
en_tdlr: This paper extends quantum Gaussian process regression to non-unitary quantum channels, proving convergence and deriving a closed-form kernel, while proposing an empirical Bayes heuristic to address exponential suppression in large-scale systems.
